name: a chest cut open in front view: a cut face with the rib cage, the two lungs, the windpipe with the voice box on top, the diaphragm as two domes with the liver under the higher one, and the stomach on the person's left
fits: anything that happens inside the chest and upper belly: hiccups, breathing, coughing, swallowing, a heartbeat; the hero is the diaphragm and the camera pans from the neck down to the stomach
recipe: one skin slab that bleeds past the frame, one cut-face panel of plaster tone, parts as flat base and shade pairs (the shade is the same shape moved down-right), ribs as curved tubes behind the lungs, the diaphragm as two arched tubes with a pale central tendon, nerves as thin white lines with yellow dashes when they fire; no sea, land, hills, iso helpers or lens
